# Rental Turtle

> Baby gear rental in Rio de Janeiro. We deliver strollers, car seats, travel cribs and other baby essentials — cleaned and sanitized — to your hotel or Airbnb, and pick everything up at the end of your trip.

Rental Turtle is a local baby-equipment rental service based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. Families traveling with young children can rent what they need on arrival instead of flying with bulky gear. Every item is deep-cleaned and sanitized before each rental and delivered ready to use.

## Service area
We deliver and pick up across Rio de Janeiro's South Zone (Zona Sul) and Barra:
Copacabana, Ipanema, Leblon, Botafogo, Flamengo, Leme, Urca, Gávea, Jardim Botânico, Barra da Tijuca.

## Catalog and daily prices (BRL)
- Baby stroller (full-size) — R$53/day
- Compact stroller — R$35/day
- Car seat — R$26/day
- Travel crib — R$38/day
- High chair — R$9/day
- Baby bathtub — R$12/day

## Rental terms
- Delivery & pickup: flat R$50 fee, regardless of how many items you rent.
- Minimum rental: 3 days; after that, price is per day.
- Refundable deposit: R$150, returned after pickup.
- Currency: Brazilian Real (BRL).
- Hours: every day, 05:00–23:00.

## How to book
Booking is done through the website cart and an email reservation form: add items, choose your dates and delivery details, and submit. We confirm your booking by email (within 24 hours).

## Languages
Portuguese, Spanish and English.
